**Summary of findings:**
- Florence's signature international dev conferences — **GoLab** (Go) and **RustLab** (Rust) — relocated to Bologna for 2026 after a decade in the city. They co-locate at the Savoia Regency Hotel Nov 1–3 (€310–460, easy 90-min train from Florence).
- **Didacta Italia** (March 11–13, 2026) was the headline Florence event: 25k+ attendees, Italy's largest EdTech fair at Fortezza da Basso. Next edition March 2027.
- Active local community layer: **GDG Firenze** (528 members, monthly meetups), **Develer TechLabs** (777 members, monthly workshops in Campi Bisenzio), and **42 Firenze** (free coding school hosting open tech events).
- Notable one-off: Italian C++ Community brought **Bjarne Stroustrup** to the University of Florence (May 2026).
